name: Text 3D — cylinder around Y axis
description: Verification preset for the text-3d Overlay (motion-primitives Phase 4.3). Text wraps onto a Y-axis cylinder; back-facing glyphs occlude themselves via CSS backface-visibility; per-glyph brightness attenuates by cos(angle) so front-facing glyphs are brightest. Cylinder rotates 90° over the timeline per the cylinder-axis-y variant.
